plan: With a private value of $30, I want to maximize potential profit. The optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value to minimize overpaying. Other bidders are rational and will likely use similar reasoning. I'll aim to bid around $25-$28 - low enough to preserve profit if I win, but high enough to have a good chance of winning. This balanced approach accounts for potential competition while protecting my potential earnings.
